name: dali-temple-route
theme: Tian Long Ba Bu inspired Dali mountain temple route, wuxia 2D pixel RPG
reason: Use GPT Image 2 for concept and visual assets, but keep runtime maps as tile/object/collision data. Directly slicing a giant generated illustration is fast for mockups but produces poor reusable tiles and inconsistent seams.

viewport.note: The map is larger than one screen; camera scrolls over this tile grid.

prompts.conceptSketch: Create a top-down pixel-inspired RPG map concept for Tian Long Ba Bu inspired Dali mountain temple route, wuxia 2D pixel RPG. Show a larger-than-screen mountain route with a temple hub, dirt paths, tall grass encounter area, training yard, water/stream edge, cliffs, gates, and a player spawn. This is a composition reference only, not a final tileset. No text, no UI, no labels.
prompts.foundationMap: Create a ground-only foundation map for Tian Long Ba Bu inspired Dali mountain temple route, wuxia 2D pixel RPG. Top-down 2D RPG perspective. Include only terrain: grass, dirt paths, stone floor, water, cliffs, and walkable boundaries. Do not include characters, buildings, trees, furniture, gates, signs, chests, labels, UI, or text.
prompts.roughTileset: Generate a rough 2D pixel-inspired RPG tileset sheet for Tian Long Ba Bu inspired Dali mountain temple route, wuxia 2D pixel RPG. Include isolated terrain tiles and compact props on a perfectly flat #FF00FF background. Needed tiles: grass, dirt path, stone floor, tall grass, water edge, cliff edge, wall/fence pieces, gate, lantern, sign, crate, rock, shrub, table, door. Every tile/prop must be separated with generous padding. No labels, no grid lines, no text.
prompts.propPack: Generate a compact prop pack for Tian Long Ba Bu inspired Dali mountain temple route, wuxia 2D pixel RPG, top-down 2D RPG perspective. Include isolated props: stone lantern, wooden gate, inn sign, market table, medicine chest, rocks, shrubs, banner, door, training dummy. Perfectly flat #FF00FF background, generous padding, no text labels.
prompts.dressedReference: Use the foundation map as visual reference and add a sparse in-world mockup of gameplay objects. Place up to 9 objects: temple gate, inn sign, medicine stall, tall grass encounter patch, training yard, stream bridge, cliff blockers, player spawn, boss gate. No annotations, no labels, no UI.
